ActionParameters.Value:
/*=====================================================
    Declarare Statusuri
=====================================================*/
DECLARE @StatusDraft INT
DECLARE @StatusBlocat INT
DECLARE @StatusConfirmat INT

SELECT @StatusDraft = Id
FROM app.StatusCalcul
WHERE Denumire = 'Draft'

SELECT @StatusBlocat = Id
FROM app.StatusCalcul
WHERE Denumire = 'Blocat'

SELECT @StatusConfirmat = Id
FROM app.StatusCalcul
WHERE Denumire = 'Confirmat'


/*=====================================================
    Creare ControlLichidare daca nu exista
=====================================================*/
IF NOT EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM app.ControlLichidare
    WHERE Anul = @Anul
      AND Luna = @Luna
      AND CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
)
BEGIN

    INSERT INTO app.ControlLichidare
    (
        Anul,
        Luna,
        CodSucursala,
        Status,
        CreatDe,
        DataCreare
    )
    VALUES
    (
        @Anul,
        @Luna,
        @CodSucursala,
        @StatusDraft,
        @UserName,
        GETDATE()
    )

END


/*=====================================================
    Validare stare luna
=====================================================*/
DECLARE @StatusCurent INT

SELECT @StatusCurent = Status
FROM app.ControlLichidare
WHERE Anul = @Anul
  AND Luna = @Luna
  AND CodSucursala = @CodSucursala


IF @StatusCurent IS NULL
BEGIN
    RAISERROR ('Nu exista ControlLichidare.',16,1)
    RETURN
END


IF @StatusCurent = @StatusBlocat
BEGIN
    RAISERROR ('Luna este blocata.',16,1)
    RETURN
END

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
DELETE FROM app.CalculLichidare
WHERE Anul = @Anul
  AND Luna = @Luna
  AND CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
SET NOCOUNT ON;

BEGIN TRY

    INSERT INTO app.CalculLichidare
    (
        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Identificare
        -------------------------------------------------
        IdSalariat,
        CodSucursala,
        Marca,
        Nume,

        Luna,
        Anul,

        DataCalcul,
        Status,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Contract
        -------------------------------------------------
        TipNorma,
        SalariuBrut,
        ValPeZi,


        ProcentLoialitate,
        ProcentContinuitate,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Prezenta
        -------------------------------------------------
        ZileLucratoare,
        ZileLucrate,
       
        ZileCO,
        ZileCM,

        OreLucrate,
        OreSup50,
        OreSup100,

        OreNoapte,
        OreSambataDuminica,

        OreGaraj,
        OreAdministrativ,
        OreIntrajudetene,

        OreAditionale,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Bruturi
        -------------------------------------------------
        SalBrutEfectiv,
        
        BrutCO,
        BrutCM,

        TotalBrut,
        BrutContributiv,
        BrutImpozabil,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Fiscalitate
        -------------------------------------------------
        VenitImpozabil,
        BazaImpozabila,

        CAS,
        CASS,
        CAM,

        DeducereStandard,
        DeducereSuplimentara,
        DeducereTotala,

        ImpozitVenit,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Sporuri / indemnizatii
        -------------------------------------------------
        ValoareLoialitate,
        ValoareContinuitate,

        IndemnizatieCFP,
        IndemnizatieConducere,
        IndemnizatieProgramFractionat,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Alte venituri
        -------------------------------------------------
        Agenti,
        Remiza,
        AlteDrepturi,

        TicheteMasa,
        Prime,
        PrimeCopii,

        ValoareOreLucrate,
        BrutOreSup50,
        BrutOreSup100,

        BrutOreSuplimentare,

        BrutNoapte,
        BrutOreSambataDuminica,

        BrutOreGaraj,
        BrutOreAdministrativ,
        BrutOreIntrajudetene,

        BrutOreAditionale,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Retineri
        -------------------------------------------------
        CAR,

        PensiiAlimentare,
        PensiiFacultative,

        Chirii,
        Casa,
        Banca,

        Garantii,

        Popriri,
        Imputatii,

        AvansCOAcordat,

        AlteRate,

        TotalRetineri,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Net
        -------------------------------------------------
        VenitNet,
        SalariuNet,
        NetDePlata,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Audit
        -------------------------------------------------
        CreatedDate,
        LastModifiedDate
    )

    SELECT

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Identificare
        -------------------------------------------------
        s.Id                           AS IdSalariat,
        s.CodSucursala                AS CodSucursala,
        s.Marca                       AS Marca,
        s.Nume                        AS Nume,

        @Luna                         AS Luna,
        @Anul                         AS Anul,

        GETDATE()                     AS DataCalcul,

        (
            SELECT TOP 1 sc.Id
            FROM app.StatusCalcul sc
            WHERE sc.Denumire = 'Draft'
            ORDER BY sc.Id
        )                             AS Status,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Contract
        -------------------------------------------------
        ISNULL(s.TipNorma, 0)         AS TipNorma,

        ISNULL(ngs.Salariu, 0)        AS SalariuBrut,
        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Valoare pe zi
        -------------------------------------------------
        CAST
        (
            ISNULL(ngs.Salariu, 0)
            /
            NULLIF(
                CAST(ISNULL(bcb.ZileLucratoare, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,6)),
                0
            )
            AS DECIMAL(18,6)
        ) AS ValPeZi,

        ISNULL(s.ProcentLoialitate, 0)
                                      AS ProcentLoialitate,

        ISNULL(s.ProcentContinuitate, 0)
                                      AS ProcentContinuitate,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Prezenta
        -------------------------------------------------

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Total zile lucratoare ale lunii
        -------------------------------------------------
        ISNULL(bcb.ZileLucratoare, 0)
                                      AS ZileLucratoare,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Zile considerate lucrate
        --
        -- ExceptiiPrezenta.ZileLucrateTotal include:
        --   - zile lucrate efectiv;
        --   - zile de delegatie;
        --   - zile libere platite;
        --   - ZLP ingrijire.
        --
        -- Aceste categorii nu sunt evidentiate separat
        -- in CalculLichidare, de aceea se preia totalul.
        -------------------------------------------------
        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Zile lucrate / prezenta salariala
        -------------------------------------------------
        ISNULL(bcb.ZileLucrate, 0)
                                    AS ZileLucrate,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Concediu de odihna
        -------------------------------------------------
        ISNULL(ep.ZileCO, 0)          AS ZileCO,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Concediu medical
        -------------------------------------------------
        ISNULL(ep.ZileCM, 0)          AS ZileCM,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Ore de prezenta efectiva
        --
        -- Orele raman preluate din BazaCalculBrut.
        -------------------------------------------------
        ISNULL(bcb.OrePrezentaEfectiva, 0)
                                      AS OreLucrate,

        ISNULL(ep.OreSuplimentare50, 0)
                                      AS OreSup50,

        ISNULL(ep.OreSuplimentare100, 0)
                                      AS OreSup100,

        ISNULL(ep.OreNoapte, 0)       AS OreNoapte,

        ISNULL(ep.OreSambataDuminica, 0)
                                      AS OreSambataDuminica,

        ISNULL(ep.OreGaraj, 0)        AS OreGaraj,

        ISNULL(ep.OreAdministrativ, 0)
                                      AS OreAdministrativ,

        ISNULL(ep.OreIntraJudetene, 0)
                                      AS OreIntrajudetene,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Total ore aditionale
        -------------------------------------------------
        (
            ISNULL(ep.OreSuplimentare50, 0)
            + ISNULL(ep.OreSuplimentare100, 0)
            + ISNULL(ep.OreNoapte, 0)
            + ISNULL(ep.OreSambataDuminica, 0)
            + ISNULL(ep.OreGaraj, 0)
            + ISNULL(ep.OreAdministrativ, 0)
            + ISNULL(ep.OreIntraJudetene, 0)
        )                             AS OreAditionale,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Bruturi
        -------------------------------------------------

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Brut aferent timpului lucrat
        --
        -- Ramane preluat din BazaCalculBrut.
        -- Nu se recalculeaza din ZileLucrateTotal.
        -------------------------------------------------
                
        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Salariu brut efectiv
        -------------------------------------------------
        ISNULL(bcb.BrutLucrat, 0) AS SalBrutEfectiv,

        ISNULL(bcb.BrutCO, 0)         AS BrutCO,

        ISNULL(bcb.BrutCM, 0)         AS BrutCM,

        ISNULL(bc.BrutTotal, 0)       AS TotalBrut,

        ISNULL(bc.BrutContributiv, 0)
                                      AS BrutContributiv,

        ISNULL(bc.BrutImpozabil, 0)   AS BrutImpozabil,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Fiscalitate
        -------------------------------------------------
        ISNULL(bc.VenitImpozabil, 0)  AS VenitImpozabil,

        ISNULL(bc.BazaImpozabila, 0)  AS BazaImpozabila,

        ISNULL(bc.CAS, 0)             AS CAS,

        ISNULL(bc.CASS, 0)            AS CASS,

        ISNULL(bc.CAM, 0)             AS CAM,

        ISNULL(bc.DeducereStandard, 0)
                                      AS DeducereStandard,

        ISNULL(bc.DeducereSuplimentara, 0)
                                      AS DeducereSuplimentara,

        ISNULL(bc.DeducereTotala, 0)  AS DeducereTotala,

        ISNULL(bc.ImpozitFinal, 0)    AS ImpozitVenit,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Sporuri / indemnizatii
        -------------------------------------------------
        ISNULL(bcb.BrutLoialitate, 0)
                                      AS ValoareLoialitate,

        ISNULL(bcb.BrutContinuitate, 0)
                                      AS ValoareContinuitate,

        ISNULL(bcb.BrutCFP, 0)        AS IndemnizatieCFP,

        ISNULL(bcb.BrutConducere, 0)  AS IndemnizatieConducere,

        ISNULL(bcb.BrutProgramFractionat, 0)
                                      AS IndemnizatieProgramFractionat,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Alte venituri
        -------------------------------------------------
        ISNULL(bcb.BrutAgenti, 0)     AS Agenti,

        ISNULL(bcb.BrutRemize, 0)     AS Remiza,

        ISNULL(bcb.BrutAlteDrepturi, 0)
                                      AS AlteDrepturi,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Tichete de masa
        --
        -- Valoarea este deja determinata in fluxul
        -- TichetMasa si preluata in BazaCalculBrut.
        -------------------------------------------------
        ISNULL(bcb.ValoareTicheteMasa, 0)
                                      AS TicheteMasa,
        
        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Prime
        -------------------------------------------------
        ISNULL(pr.PrimaNet, 0)        AS Prime,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Prime copii
        -------------------------------------------------
        ISNULL(pc.PrimaCopiiNet, 0)   AS PrimeCopii,

        ISNULL(bcb.BrutLucrat, 0)     AS ValoareOreLucrate,

        ISNULL(bcb.BrutOreSup50, 0)   AS BrutOreSup50,

        ISNULL(bcb.BrutOreSup100, 0)  AS BrutOreSup100,

        ISNULL(bcb.BrutOreSuplimentare, 0)
                                      AS BrutOreSuplimentare,

        ISNULL(bcb.BrutNoapte, 0)     AS BrutNoapte,

        ISNULL(bcb.BrutSambataDuminica, 0)
                                      AS BrutOreSambataDuminica,

        ISNULL(bcb.BrutGaraj, 0)      AS BrutOreGaraj,

        ISNULL(bcb.BrutAdministrativ, 0)
                                      AS BrutOreAdministrativ,

        ISNULL(bcb.BrutIntrajudetene, 0)
                                      AS BrutOreIntrajudetene,

        ISNULL(bcb.BrutOreAditionale, 0)
                                      AS BrutOreAditionale,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Retineri
        -------------------------------------------------
        ISNULL(car2.CAR, 0)           AS CAR,

        ISNULL(pa.PensiiAlimentare, 0)
                                      AS PensiiAlimentare,

        ISNULL(ret.PensiiFacultative, 0)
                                      AS PensiiFacultative,

        ISNULL(ret.Chirii, 0)         AS Chirii,

        ISNULL(ret.Casa, 0)           AS Casa,

        ISNULL(ret.Banca, 0)          AS Banca,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Garantii
        --
        -- Momentan nu sunt calculate in acest INSERT.
        -------------------------------------------------
        0                             AS Garantii,

        ISNULL(pop.Popriri, 0)        AS Popriri,

        ISNULL(imp.Imputatii, 0)      AS Imputatii,

        ISNULL(avansCO.AvansCOAcordat, 0)
                                      AS AvansCOAcordat,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Alte rate
        --
        -- Momentan nu sunt calculate in acest INSERT.
        -------------------------------------------------
        0                             AS AlteRate,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Total retineri
        -------------------------------------------------
        (
            ISNULL(car2.CAR, 0)
            + ISNULL(pa.PensiiAlimentare, 0)
            + ISNULL(ret.PensiiFacultative, 0)
            + ISNULL(ret.Chirii, 0)
            + ISNULL(ret.Casa, 0)
            + ISNULL(ret.Banca, 0)

            -------------------------------------------------
            -- Garantii = 0
            -------------------------------------------------
            + 0

            + ISNULL(pop.Popriri, 0)
            + ISNULL(imp.Imputatii, 0)
            + ISNULL(avansCO.AvansCOAcordat, 0)

            -------------------------------------------------
            -- AlteRate = 0
            -------------------------------------------------
            + 0
        )                             AS TotalRetineri,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Venit Net
        -------------------------------------------------
        (
            ISNULL(bc.VenitImpozabil, 0)
            - ISNULL(bc.ImpozitFinal, 0)
        )                             AS VenitNet,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Salariu Net
        -------------------------------------------------
        (
            ISNULL(bc.VenitImpozabil, 0)
            - ISNULL(bc.ImpozitFinal, 0)
        )                             AS SalariuNet,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Net de plata
        --
        -- Din salariul net se scad:
        --   - valoarea tichetelor de masa;
        --   - toate retinerile.
        -------------------------------------------------
        (
            (
                ISNULL(bc.VenitImpozabil, 0)
                - ISNULL(bc.ImpozitFinal, 0)
                
                + ISNULL(pr.PrimaNet, 0)
                + ISNULL(pc.PrimaCopiiNet, 0)
                
                - ISNULL(bcb.ValoareTicheteMasa, 0)
            )
            -
            (
                ISNULL(car2.CAR, 0)
                + ISNULL(pa.PensiiAlimentare, 0)
                + ISNULL(ret.PensiiFacultative, 0)
                + ISNULL(ret.Chirii, 0)
                + ISNULL(ret.Casa, 0)
                + ISNULL(ret.Banca, 0)

                -------------------------------------------------
                -- Garantii = 0
                -------------------------------------------------
                + 0

                + ISNULL(pop.Popriri, 0)
                + ISNULL(imp.Imputatii, 0)
                + ISNULL(avansCO.AvansCOAcordat, 0)

                -------------------------------------------------
                -- AlteRate = 0
                -------------------------------------------------
                + 0
            )
        )                             AS NetDePlata,

        -------------------------------------------------
        -- Audit
        -------------------------------------------------
        GETDATE()                     AS CreatedDate,

        GETDATE()                     AS LastModifiedDate

    FROM app.Salariat s

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Exceptii prezenta
    -------------------------------------------------
    LEFT JOIN app.ExceptiiPrezenta ep
        ON ep.Marca = s.Marca
       AND ep.Anul = @Anul
       AND ep.Luna = @Luna
       AND ep.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Baza calcul brut
    -------------------------------------------------
    LEFT JOIN app.BazaCalculBrut bcb
        ON bcb.Marca = s.Marca
       AND bcb.Anul = @Anul
       AND bcb.Luna = @Luna
       AND bcb.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Baza contributii
    -------------------------------------------------
    LEFT JOIN app.BazaContributii bc
        ON bc.Marca = s.Marca
       AND bc.Anul = @Anul
       AND bc.Luna = @Luna
       AND bc.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Grila salarizare
    -------------------------------------------------
    LEFT JOIN app.NomGrilaSalarizare ngs
        ON ngs.Clasa = s.Clasa
       AND ngs.TipMediu = 'U'

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- CAR
    -------------------------------------------------
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT
            SUM
            (
                ISNULL(c.RataLunara, 0)
            ) AS CAR

        FROM app.CAR c

        WHERE c.Marca = s.Marca
          AND c.Anul = @Anul
          AND c.Luna = @Luna
          AND c.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
    ) car2

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Pensii alimentare
    -------------------------------------------------
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT
            SUM
            (
                ISNULL(pa2.Rata, 0)
                + ISNULL(pa2.Rest, 0)
                + ISNULL(pa2.Taxa, 0)
                + ISNULL(pa2.Taxam, 0)
            ) AS PensiiAlimentare

        FROM app.PensieAlimentara pa2

        WHERE pa2.Marca = s.Marca
          AND pa2.Anul = @Anul
          AND pa2.Luna = @Luna
          AND pa2.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
    ) pa

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Imputatii
    -------------------------------------------------
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT
            SUM
            (
                ISNULL(i.Rata, 0)
                + ISNULL(i.Dobanda, 0)
                + ISNULL(i.Restanta, 0)
            ) AS Imputatii

        FROM app.Imputatie i

        WHERE i.Marca = s.Marca
          AND i.Anul = @Anul
          AND i.Luna = @Luna
          AND i.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
    ) imp

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Popriri
    -------------------------------------------------
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT
            SUM
            (
                ISNULL(p.Rata, 0)
                + ISNULL(p.Dobanda, 0)
                + ISNULL(p.Restanta, 0)
            ) AS Popriri

        FROM app.Poprire p

        WHERE p.Marca = s.Marca
          AND p.Anul = @Anul
          AND p.Luna = @Luna
          AND p.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
    ) pop

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Retineri
    --
    -- TipRata:
    --   1 = Chirii
    --   2 = Casa
    --   3 = Banca
    --   7 = Pensii facultative
    -------------------------------------------------
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT

            -------------------------------------------------
            -- Chirii
            -------------------------------------------------
            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN r.TipRata = 1
                    THEN
                        ISNULL(r.Rata, 0)
                        + ISNULL(r.Dobanda, 0)
                        + ISNULL(r.RestDePlata, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) AS Chirii,

            -------------------------------------------------
            -- Casa
            -------------------------------------------------
            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN r.TipRata = 2
                    THEN
                        ISNULL(r.Rata, 0)
                        + ISNULL(r.Dobanda, 0)
                        + ISNULL(r.RestDePlata, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) AS Casa,

            -------------------------------------------------
            -- Banca
            -------------------------------------------------
            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN r.TipRata = 3
                    THEN
                        ISNULL(r.Rata, 0)
                        + ISNULL(r.Dobanda, 0)
                        + ISNULL(r.RestDePlata, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) AS Banca,

            -------------------------------------------------
            -- Pensii facultative
            -------------------------------------------------
            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN r.TipRata = 7
                    THEN
                        ISNULL(r.Rata, 0)
                        + ISNULL(r.Dobanda, 0)
                        + ISNULL(r.RestDePlata, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) AS PensiiFacultative

        FROM app.Retinere r

        WHERE r.Marca = s.Marca
          AND r.Anul = @Anul
          AND r.Luna = @Luna
          AND r.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
    ) ret

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Avans concediu de odihna acordat
    -------------------------------------------------
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT
            SUM
            (
                -------------------------------------------------
                -- Interval 1
                -------------------------------------------------
                CASE
                    WHEN co.Interval1DatadeInceput IS NOT NULL
                     AND YEAR(co.Interval1DatadeInceput) = @Anul
                     AND MONTH(co.Interval1DatadeInceput) = @Luna
                    THEN ISNULL(co.AvansCO1, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END

                +

                -------------------------------------------------
                -- Interval 2
                -------------------------------------------------
                CASE
                    WHEN co.Interval2DatadeInceput IS NOT NULL
                     AND YEAR(co.Interval2DatadeInceput) = @Anul
                     AND MONTH(co.Interval2DatadeInceput) = @Luna
                    THEN ISNULL(co.AvansCO2, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END

                +

                -------------------------------------------------
                -- Interval 3
                -------------------------------------------------
                CASE
                    WHEN co.Interval3DatadeInceput IS NOT NULL
                     AND YEAR(co.Interval3DatadeInceput) = @Anul
                     AND MONTH(co.Interval3DatadeInceput) = @Luna
                    THEN ISNULL(co.AvansCO3, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) AS AvansCOAcordat

        FROM app.ConcediudeOdihna co

        WHERE co.Marca = s.Marca
          AND co.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
          AND ISNULL(co.Avans, '') IN ('D', 'DA', '1')
          AND
          (
                ISNULL(co.AvansCO1, 0) <> 0
             OR ISNULL(co.AvansCO2, 0) <> 0
             OR ISNULL(co.AvansCO3, 0) <> 0
          )
    ) avansCO

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Prime
    -------------------------------------------------
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT
            SUM(ISNULL(p.PrimaNet, 0)) AS PrimaNet
        FROM app.Prima p
        WHERE p.Marca = s.Marca
          AND p.Anul = @Anul
          AND p.Luna = @Luna
          AND p.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
          AND p.Status = 2
    ) pr

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Prime copii
    -------------------------------------------------
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT
            SUM(ISNULL(pc2.PrimaNet, 0)) AS PrimaCopiiNet
        FROM app.PrimaCopii pc2
        WHERE pc2.Marca = s.Marca
          AND pc2.Anul = @Anul
          AND pc2.Luna = @Luna
          AND pc2.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
          AND pc2.Status = 2
    ) pc

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Filtrare salariati
    -------------------------------------------------
    WHERE s.Anul = @Anul
      AND s.Luna = @Luna
      AND s.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala;

END TRY

BEGIN CATCH

    THROW;

END CATCH;

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
SET NOCOUNT ON;

BEGIN TRY

    /*=====================================================
      ȘTERGEREA EXCEPȚIILOR VECHI

      La fiecare reluare a calculului se șterg validările
      generate anterior pentru aceeași perioadă și aceeași
      sucursală.
    =====================================================*/

    DELETE FROM app.ExceptiiLichidare
    WHERE Anul = @Anul
      AND Luna = @Luna
      AND CodSucursala = @CodSucursala;


    /*=====================================================
      1. NET NEGATIV

      Validare blocantă.

      NetDePlata conține:
        VenitNet
        - TicheteMasa
        - TotalRetineri
    =====================================================*/

    INSERT INTO app.ExceptiiLichidare
    (
        Anul,
        Luna,
        CodSucursala,

        Marca,
        Nume,

        TipExceptie,
        Severitate,
        Mesaj,

        CreatedDate
    )
    SELECT
        cl.Anul,
        cl.Luna,
        cl.CodSucursala,

        cl.Marca,
        cl.Nume,

        'NET_NEGATIV',
        'BLOCK',
        'Netul de plata este negativ.',

        GETDATE()

    FROM app.CalculLichidare cl

    WHERE cl.Anul = @Anul
      AND cl.Luna = @Luna
      AND cl.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
      AND ISNULL(cl.NetDePlata, 0) < 0;


    /*=====================================================
      2. FĂRĂ VENIT BRUT

      Atenționare pentru salariații pentru care nu s-a
      calculat niciun venit brut.
    =====================================================*/

    INSERT INTO app.ExceptiiLichidare
    (
        Anul,
        Luna,
        CodSucursala,

        Marca,
        Nume,

        TipExceptie,
        Severitate,
        Mesaj,

        CreatedDate
    )
    SELECT
        cl.Anul,
        cl.Luna,
        cl.CodSucursala,

        cl.Marca,
        cl.Nume,

        'FARA_BRUT',
        'WARNING',
        'Salariat fara venit brut calculat.',

        GETDATE()

    FROM app.CalculLichidare cl

    WHERE cl.Anul = @Anul
      AND cl.Luna = @Luna
      AND cl.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
      AND ISNULL(cl.TotalBrut, 0) = 0;


    /*=====================================================
      3. FĂRĂ PREZENȚĂ SALARIALĂ

      ZileLucrate conține acum:
        - zile lucrate efectiv;
        - delegații;
        - zile libere plătite;
        - ZLP îngrijire.

      Salariatul este considerat fără prezență salarială
      dacă nu are:
        - zile considerate lucrate;
        - concediu de odihnă;
        - concediu medical.

      Este o informare, nu o blocare, deoarece poate exista:
        - CFS;
        - suspendare;
        - zile fără contract;
        - alte situații justificate.
    =====================================================*/

    INSERT INTO app.ExceptiiLichidare
    (
        Anul,
        Luna,
        CodSucursala,

        Marca,
        Nume,

        TipExceptie,
        Severitate,
        Mesaj,

        CreatedDate
    )
    SELECT
        cl.Anul,
        cl.Luna,
        cl.CodSucursala,

        cl.Marca,
        cl.Nume,

        'FARA_PREZENTA',
        'INFO',
        'Salariat fara zile lucrate, concediu de odihna sau concediu medical.',

        GETDATE()

    FROM app.CalculLichidare cl

    WHERE cl.Anul = @Anul
      AND cl.Luna = @Luna
      AND cl.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

      AND ISNULL(cl.ZileLucrate, 0) = 0
      AND ISNULL(cl.ZileCO, 0) = 0
      AND ISNULL(cl.ZileCM, 0) = 0;


    /*=====================================================
      4. DEPĂȘIREA ZILELOR LUCRĂTOARE

      Formula verificată:

        ZileLucrate
        + ZileCO
        + ZileCM
        <= ZileLucratoare

      ZileLucrate reprezintă ZileLucrateTotal din
      ExceptiiPrezenta și include:
        - prezența efectivă;
        - delegațiile;
        - zilele libere plătite;
        - ZLP îngrijire.
    =====================================================*/

    INSERT INTO app.ExceptiiLichidare
    (
        Anul,
        Luna,
        CodSucursala,

        Marca,
        Nume,

        TipExceptie,
        Severitate,
        Mesaj,

        CreatedDate
    )
    SELECT
        cl.Anul,
        cl.Luna,
        cl.CodSucursala,

        cl.Marca,
        cl.Nume,

        'ZILE_DEPASIRE',
        'BLOCK',

        'Totalul zilelor considerate lucrate, CO si CM depaseste zilele lucratoare ale lunii. '
        + 'Total calculat: '
        + CAST
          (
              ISNULL(cl.ZileLucrate, 0)
              + ISNULL(cl.ZileCO, 0)
              + ISNULL(cl.ZileCM, 0)
              AS NVARCHAR(20)
          )
        + '. Zile lucratoare: '
        + CAST
          (
              ISNULL(cl.ZileLucratoare, 0)
              AS NVARCHAR(20)
          )
        + '.',

        GETDATE()

    FROM app.CalculLichidare cl

    WHERE cl.Anul = @Anul
      AND cl.Luna = @Luna
      AND cl.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

      AND
      (
          ISNULL(cl.ZileLucrate, 0)
          + ISNULL(cl.ZileCO, 0)
          + ISNULL(cl.ZileCM, 0)
      ) > ISNULL(cl.ZileLucratoare, 0);


    /*=====================================================
      5. RETENȚII MAI MARI DECÂT VENITUL DISPONIBIL

      Venitul disponibil pentru rețineri este:

        VenitNet - TicheteMasa

      Tichetele de masă sunt fiscalizate, dar nu se achită
      în numerar odată cu salariul.

      Formula trebuie să fie identică logic cu formula
      utilizată pentru NetDePlata.
    =====================================================*/

    INSERT INTO app.ExceptiiLichidare
    (
        Anul,
        Luna,
        CodSucursala,

        Marca,
        Nume,

        TipExceptie,
        Severitate,
        Mesaj,

        CreatedDate
    )
    SELECT
        cl.Anul,
        cl.Luna,
        cl.CodSucursala,

        cl.Marca,
        cl.Nume,

        'RETINERI_DEPASITE',
        'BLOCK',

        'Retinerile depasesc venitul disponibil dupa scaderea tichetelor de masa. '
        + 'Retineri: '
        + CAST
          (
              ISNULL(cl.TotalRetineri, 0)
              AS NVARCHAR(50)
          )
        + '. Venit disponibil: '
        + CAST
          (
              ISNULL(cl.VenitNet, 0)
              - ISNULL(cl.TicheteMasa, 0)
              AS NVARCHAR(50)
          )
        + '.',

        GETDATE()

    FROM app.CalculLichidare cl

    WHERE cl.Anul = @Anul
      AND cl.Luna = @Luna
      AND cl.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

      AND ISNULL(cl.TotalRetineri, 0)
          >
          (
              ISNULL(cl.VenitNet, 0)
              - ISNULL(cl.TicheteMasa, 0)
          );


    /*=====================================================
      6. FĂRĂ CONTRIBUȚII

      Se verifică doar salariații care au venit brut.

      Validarea este WARNING deoarece pot exista situații
      legale de scutire sau categorii speciale.
    =====================================================*/

    INSERT INTO app.ExceptiiLichidare
    (
        Anul,
        Luna,
        CodSucursala,

        Marca,
        Nume,

        TipExceptie,
        Severitate,
        Mesaj,

        CreatedDate
    )
    SELECT
        cl.Anul,
        cl.Luna,
        cl.CodSucursala,

        cl.Marca,
        cl.Nume,

        'FARA_CONTRIBUTII',
        'WARNING',
        'Salariat cu venit brut, dar fara CAS si CASS calculate.',

        GETDATE()

    FROM app.CalculLichidare cl

    WHERE cl.Anul = @Anul
      AND cl.Luna = @Luna
      AND cl.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

      AND ISNULL(cl.TotalBrut, 0) > 0
      AND ISNULL(cl.CAS, 0) = 0
      AND ISNULL(cl.CASS, 0) = 0;


    /*=====================================================
      7. FĂRĂ IMPOZIT

      Se verifică numai cazurile în care baza impozabilă
      este mai mare decât zero.

      Rămâne INFO, deoarece deducerile sau facilitățile
      fiscale pot conduce legal la impozit zero.
    =====================================================*/

    INSERT INTO app.ExceptiiLichidare
    (
        Anul,
        Luna,
        CodSucursala,

        Marca,
        Nume,

        TipExceptie,
        Severitate,
        Mesaj,

        CreatedDate
    )
    SELECT
        cl.Anul,
        cl.Luna,
        cl.CodSucursala,

        cl.Marca,
        cl.Nume,

        'FARA_IMPOZIT',
        'INFO',
        'Baza impozabila este pozitiva, dar impozitul pe venit este zero.',

        GETDATE()

    FROM app.CalculLichidare cl

    WHERE cl.Anul = @Anul
      AND cl.Luna = @Luna
      AND cl.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

      AND ISNULL(cl.BazaImpozabila, 0) > 0
      AND ISNULL(cl.ImpozitVenit, 0) = 0;


END TRY

BEGIN CATCH

    THROW;

END CATCH;
